title: Penguin Life's Matt James announces the UK edition — 'a truly radical book'
summary: James is a senior commissioning editor at Penguin Life. He announced the UK edition, which Penguin Business published on 28 May 2026, two days after the US launch.
blockquote: This is a truly radical book which uncovers the urgent need for purpose-driven business in a world lacking integrity.
blockquote_source: Matt James, Penguin Life, on LinkedIn

source_urls.label: The UK edition on Penguin's own site: Penguin Business, 28 May 2026, 432 pages, ISBN 9780241692028
